newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr opens firmer, markets await U.S data.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr opens firmer, markets await U.S data.

text.p: Canada's dollar opened slightly firmer at C$1.3982 (US$0.7152) in light trading on Tuesday in advance of key U.S. inflation data due later this morning, traders said.
They said that any signs of higher inflation in the U.S. consumer price index would push the Canada dollar through short-term resistance at the C$1.4000 (US$0.7142) level.

A Reuters poll predicted that U.S. CPI would rise 0.2 percent in March and the CPI excluding food and energy by 0.3 percent for the same period. A sharp spike in inflation could prompt more U.S. interest rate rises.
